summary: Iteration 20 — Approval workflow (GRN/DC/CS) + LLM Co-pilot (suggestion-only). 40/40 tests pass. Verified: (A.1) POST /api/grn/{id}/approve — admin/director approve (200), purchase 403, pm 403; audit_logs entry action='grn_approve' with old_value.status/new_value.status; re-approving already-approved GRN → 400. (A.2) GET /api/grn/{id} new endpoint returns single GRN and 404 for unknown id. (A.3) POST /api/dc/{id}/approve — admin/director 200, purchase 403, pm 403; audit action='dc_approve' with correct old/new status; rejected DCs can be re-approved; approved DCs cannot be re-approved (400); reject without comment still allowed. (A.4) PUT /api/dc/{id} on approved DC by purchase → 400 'locked'; admin/director can PUT-edit through the lock. (A.5) POST /api/comparative-statement/{id}/approve — pm/gm/director 200, purchase 403, admin 403 (role split enforced); audit action='cs_approve'. (B.1) LLM item-standardise (Haiku cheap): returns suggestion_id, status='pending_review', tier='cheap', model='claude-haiku-4-5-20251001'; output_parsed.suggestions[] never references a MAT-#### UID outside the approved catalogue; site_engineer 403; empty description 400. (B.2) LLM quotation-compare (Sonnet premium): 2 quotes → 200 tier='premium', model='claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929'; 1 quote → 400; 7 quotes → 400. (B.3) LLM reconcile (Sonnet premium): valid po_id (po_29138a4399ed) → 200 with per_line 3-way structure; invalid po_id → 404; site_engineer 403. (B.4) GET /api/llm/suggestions — purchase can list pending_review, site_engineer 403. (B.5) POST /api/llm/suggestions/{id}/decide — accept updates status='accepted', decided_by set; audit_logs action='llm_accept' with old_value.status='pending_review' new_value.status='accepted'; reject with reason 200; already-decided → 400. (B.6) audit_logs entry per LLM call: entity='llm', action='llm_call_item_standardise' with details.tier + details.model + numeric details.chars_in/chars_out. (B.7) Cache: repeating identical prompt returns identical output_raw (llm_cache hit). (B.8) Workflow isolation: after running item-standardise + quotation-compare + reconcile, counts of mrfs/pos/grns/dcs/invoices/materials/variants/customers/vendors/comparative_statements are unchanged. (Regression) GRN/DC export PDFs and CS download still work — %PDF returned, file bytes stream through.
